skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the principles, practices, and policies for sustainable tourism.
Comprehend key concepts related to ecotourism.
Analyze the economic impact of ecotourism on local economies.
Evaluate the social impact of ecotourism on local communities.
Assess the environmental impact of ecotourism on natural resources.
Develop marketing strategies for nature-based tourism businesses.
Plan and manage ecotourism activities based on conservation principles.
